+class JSONDecoder:
+    """Incrementally decode JSON documents, lines, or text sequences."""
+
+    def __init__(self, content_type: str) -> None:
+        media_type = content_type.partition(";")[0].strip().lower()
+        if media_type in ("application/ndjson", "application/x-ndjson"):
+            self.mode = "lines"
+        elif media_type == "application/json-seq":
+            self.mode = "sequence"
+        elif media_type == "application/json" or (
+            media_type.startswith("application/") and media_type.endswith("+json")
+        ):
+            self.mode = "document"
+        else:
+            raise DecodingError("Unsupported Content-Type for JSON iteration.")
+
+        message = email.message.Message()
+        message["content-type"] = content_type
+        encoding = message.get_content_charset()
+        self.decoder: codecs.IncrementalDecoder | None = None
+        if message.get_param("charset") is not None:
+            if encoding is None:
+                raise DecodingError("Invalid JSON charset.")
+            if codecs.lookup(encoding).name == "utf-8-sig":
+                encoding = "utf-8"
+            self.decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder(encoding)(errors="strict")
+        self.prefix = b""
+        self.buffer = ""
+        self.state = "start"
+        self.bom_seen = False
+        self.first_line = True

+_RS = "\x1e"

+

+        if _JSON_DOCUMENT_MEDIA_TYPE.fullmatch(media_type):
+            self._parser = _JSONDocument()
+        elif media_type in ("application/ndjson", "application/x-ndjson"):
+            self._parser = _JSONRecords(sequence=False)
+        elif media_type == "application/json-seq":
+            self._parser = _JSONRecords(sequence=True)
+        else:
+            raise DecodingError("Expected a JSON response Content-Type.")
+
+        self._sequence = media_type == "application/json-seq"
+        self._decoder: codecs.IncrementalDecoder | None = None
+        self._prefix = b""

+            self._decoder = self._text_decoder(header.get_content_charset() or "")

+    def _text_decoder(self, encoding: str) -> codecs.IncrementalDecoder:
+        try:
+            codec = codecs.lookup(encoding)
+            if not codec._is_text_encoding or codec.incrementaldecoder is None:
+                raise LookupError(encoding)
+            if codec.name == "utf-8-sig" and not self._sequence:
+                # Document and line parsers enforce the position and count of BOMs.
+                return codecs.getincrementaldecoder("utf-8")()
+            return codec.incrementaldecoder()
+        except (LookupError, ValueError) as exc:
+            raise DecodingError(f"Invalid JSON charset: {encoding!r}.") from exc

+    (primitive '<= 2 (lambda (a b) (<= (text-value a) (text-value b))))
+    (primitive '>= 2 (lambda (a b) (>= (text-value a) (text-value b))))

+    (primitive 'cdr 1 guest-cdr)

+    (primitive 'pair? 1 guest-pair?)
+    (primitive 'eq? 2 same-value?)

+    (primitive 'string? 1 guest-string?)

+    (primitive 'set-cdr! 2

+  (define (next) (scan port #f))

+"""Public-boundary checks for the metacircular evaluator."""
+import pathlib
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+
+ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+
+def run(program, data, cwd):
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "interp.py"), str(program)],
+        input=data, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd, timeout=120,
+    )
+    if result.returncode:
+        raise AssertionError(f"Interpreter exited with status {result.returncode}")
+    return result.stdout
+
+
+class EvaluatorTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_source_forms_are_not_lost_at_line_boundaries(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            program = pathlib.Path(directory) / "source forms.scm"
+            program.write_text(
+                "; leading comment\n() (define x\n41) (display (+ x 1))\n"
+                "(newline) ; trailing comment\n"
+                "(display \"literal ( ; )\") (newline)\n"
+                "'ignored (display 'finished)\n"
+            )
+            expected = run(program, "", directory)
+            self.assertEqual(expected, "42\nliteral ( ; )\nfinished")
+            for prefix in ("", str(ROOT / "eval.scm") + "\n"):
+                with self.subTest(prefix=prefix):
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        run(ROOT / "eval.scm", prefix + str(program) + "\n", directory),
+                        expected,
+                    )
+
+    def test_programs_and_self_interpretation(self):
+        inputs = {
+            "calculator.scm": "(+ 7 8)\n",
+            "test_read.scm": "(hello 42)\n",
+            "06-interactive-io.scm": "7\n8\n+\n",
+        }
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            for program in sorted((ROOT / "test").glob("*.scm")):
+                with self.subTest(program=program.name):
+                    data = inputs.get(program.name, "")
+                    expected = run(program, data, directory)
+                    self.assertNotIn("error:", expected.lower())
+                    actual = run(ROOT / "eval.scm", str(program) + "\n" + data, directory)
+                    self.assertEqual(actual, expected)
+            program = ROOT / "test/calculator.scm"
+            data = "(+ 7 8)\n"
+            self.assertEqual(
+                run(ROOT / "eval.scm", str(ROOT / "eval.scm") + "\n" + str(program) + "\n" + data, directory),
+                run(program, data, directory),
+            )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+;; Read a source path from stdin, then evaluate the file in a fresh environment.
+;; Guest I/O uses the same streams as the evaluator.

+(define failed #f)
+
+(define (fail message detail)
+  (if (not failed)

+        (set! failed #t)
+        (display "Error: ")
+        (display message)
+        (display detail)
+        (newline))))
+
+(define (second xs) (car (cdr xs)))
+(define (rest2 xs) (cdr (cdr xs)))

+;; The host does not eliminate tail calls. Split growing batches in half so
+;; earlier steps do not leave a stack frame for every later step.
+(define (run-batch step size)
+  (if (= size 1)
+      (step)
+      (let ((half (/ size 2)))
+        (if (run-batch step half) (run-batch step half) #f))))
+
+(define (run-until-done step size)
+  (if (run-batch step size)
+      (run-until-done step (* size 2))))
+
+(define (read-path)
+  (let ((head (cons '() '())))
+    (let ((tail head))
+      (run-until-done
+        (lambda ()
+          (let ((ch (getchr)))
+            (if (= ch 10)
+                #f
+                (let ((next (cons ch '())))
+                  (set-cdr! tail next)
+                  (set! tail next)
+                  #t))))
+        1))
+    (symbol (cdr head))))

+(define end-of-source (cons '() '()))

+(define false-token (symbol (cons 35 (cons 102 '()))))

+(define (source-string? value)
+  (if (pair? value) (eq? (car value) string-tag) #f))
+
+(define (string-text value)
+  (if (source-string? value) (cdr value) value))
+
+(define (whitespace? ch)
+  (cond ((= ch 32) #t)
+        ((< ch 32) (or (and (>= ch 9) (<= ch 13)) (and (>= ch 28) (<= ch 31))))

+                  (and (>= ch 8192) (<= ch 8202))
+                  (= ch 8232) (= ch 8233) (= ch 8239) (= ch 8287) (= ch 12288)))))

+  (let ((ch (car input)))

+
+(define (skip-comment input)
+  (let ((ch (car input)))
+    (if (and (>= ch 0) (not (= ch 10)))
+        (begin (advance input) (skip-comment input)))))
+
+(define (skip-space input)
+  (let ((ch (car input)))
+    (cond ((= ch 59) (skip-comment input) (skip-space input))
+          ((whitespace? ch) (advance input) (skip-space input)))))
+
+(define (read-source-string input chars)
+  (let ((ch (advance input)))
+    (cond ((< ch 0) (fail "Unterminated string" ""))
+          ((= ch 34) (cons string-tag (symbol (reverse-onto chars '()))))
+          ((= ch 92)

+          (else (read-source-string input (cons ch chars))))))
+
+(define (starts-with-digit? chars)
+  (if (pair? chars) (and (>= (car chars) 48) (<= (car chars) 57)) #f))
+
+(define (parse-digits chars value)
+  (cond ((null? chars) value)
+        ((starts-with-digit? chars)

+(define (atom-end? ch)

+          ((= ch 41) close-paren)

+;; Each frame owns its bindings. Closures keep the frame, not a copy of its

+  (let ((binding (find-local (car env) name)))
+    (if binding (set-cdr! binding value)
+        (set-car! env (cons (cons name value) (car env))))))
+
+(define (bind-parameters env params args)
+  (cond ((null? params)
+         (if (pair? args) (fail "Too many arguments" "")))
+        ((null? args) (fail "Too few arguments" ""))
+        (else (define-binding env (car params) (car args))
+              (bind-parameters env (cdr params) (cdr args)))))
+
+;; Both guest closures and primitive adapters take one evaluated argument list.
+(define (make-closure params body env)
+  (lambda (args)
+    (let ((local (make-env env)))
+      (bind-parameters local params args)
+      (eval-sequence body local))))
+
+(define (eval-sequence body env)
+  (if (or failed (null? body)) '()
+      (let ((value (eval-expr (car body) env)))
+        (if (null? (cdr body)) value
+            (eval-sequence (cdr body) env)))))
+
+(define (eval-operands exprs env)
+  (if (or failed (null? exprs)) '()
+      (cons (eval-expr (car exprs) env)
+            (eval-operands (cdr exprs) env))))
+
+(define (eval-bindings bindings env local)
+  (if (not (or failed (null? bindings)))
+      (let ((binding (car bindings)))
+        (define-binding local (car binding) (eval-expr (second binding) env))
+        (eval-bindings (cdr bindings) env local))))
+
+(define (eval-cond clauses env)
+  (if (or failed (null? clauses)) '()
+      (let ((clause (car clauses)))
+        (if (if (eq? (car clause) 'else) #t (eval-expr (car clause) env))
+            (eval-sequence (cdr clause) env)
+            (eval-cond (cdr clauses) env)))))

+(define (eval-application operator operands env)
+  (let ((proc (eval-expr operator env)))
+    (let ((args (eval-operands operands env)))
+      (cond (failed '())
+            ((or (pair? proc) (null? proc) (number? proc) (string? proc) (symbol? proc))
+             (fail "Not a procedure: " (string-text proc)))
+            (else (proc args))))))
+
+(define (eval-expr expr env)
+  (cond (failed '())
+        ((symbol? expr) (cdr (find-binding env expr)))
+        ((or (not (pair? expr)) (source-string? expr)) expr)
+        (else
+         (let ((operator (car expr)) (args (cdr expr)))
+           (cond ((eq? operator 'quote) (car args))
+                 ((eq? operator 'if)
+                  (if (eval-expr (car args) env)
+                      (eval-expr (second args) env)
+                      (eval-expr (car (rest2 args)) env)))
+                 ((eq? operator 'define)
+                  (let ((target (car args)))
+                    (if (pair? target)
+                        (define-binding env (car target) (make-closure (cdr target) (cdr args) env))
+                        (define-binding env target (eval-expr (second args) env)))))
+                 ((eq? operator 'set!)
+                  (let ((value (eval-expr (second args) env)))
+                    (let ((binding (find-binding env (car args))))
+                      (if binding (set-cdr! binding value)))))
+                 ((eq? operator 'lambda) (make-closure (car args) (cdr args) env))
+                 ((eq? operator 'let)
+                  (let ((local (make-env env)))
+                    (eval-bindings (car args) env local)
+                    (eval-sequence (cdr args) local)))

+                  (eval-sequence args env))
+                 ((eq? operator 'cond) (eval-cond args env))
+                 (else (eval-application operator args env)))))))
+
+(define (primitive0 proc)
+  (lambda (args)
+    (if (null? args) (proc) (fail "Expected no arguments" ""))))
+
+(define (primitive1 proc)
+  (lambda (args)
+    (if (and (pair? args) (null? (cdr args)))
+        (proc (car args))
+        (fail "Expected one argument" ""))))
+
+(define (primitive2 proc)
+  (lambda (args)
+    (if (and (pair? args) (pair? (cdr args)) (null? (rest2 args)))
+        (proc (car args) (second args))
+        (fail "Expected two arguments" ""))))

+(define (fold-args proc value args)
+  (if (null? args) value
+      (fold-args proc (proc value (car args)) (cdr args))))
+
+(define (variadic proc identity)
+  (lambda (args) (fold-args proc identity args)))

+(define (guest-minus args)
+  (cond ((null? args) (fail "Expected one or two arguments" ""))
+        ((null? (cdr args)) (- (car args)))
+        ((null? (rest2 args)) (- (car args) (second args)))
+        (else (fail "Expected one or two arguments" ""))))
